These are analysis workflows that can be run now, or that are in development. The [workflow diagrams](workflows.qmd) show conceptually how analysis steps can be assembled. Here we describe the implemented pipelines themselves.

Defaults for these pipelines are guided by the [benchmarking](benchmarking.qmd).

## Drug resistance

A drug resistance pipeline is available on nf-core as [nf-core/plasmodiumdrugres](https://nf-co.re/plasmodiumdrugres). Methods in the pipeline are interchangeable.

This pipeline estimates allele frequencies and prevalences at both single-locus and multi-locus levels. Microhaplotype data can be supplied in the form of an allele table or a [PMO file](https://plasmogenepi.github.io/PMO_Docs/).

A version of this pipeline is also available on Terra. The pipeline can be loaded into a workspace and run there, although there is not a featured workspace yet. Reach out to [Kathryn Murie](mailto:kathryn.murie@ucsf.edu) if you would like to try it out on Terra before it is publically available in a workspace.

## Population genetics

A population genetics pipeline has been [proposed and approved by nf-core](https://github.com/nf-core/proposals/issues/161). It is under development. Stay tuned, and reach out to [Kathryn Murie](mailto:kathryn.murie@ucsf.edu) if you would like to try out a pre-release version.
